chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail who said:
I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) regarding a slave girl of a young son of mine, 'Is it allowed for me to sleep with her?' So he (peace be upon him) wrote: 'No, until you free her'.

key_terms.أَطَأ: To sleep with / consummate marriage with

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a father sleeping with a slave girl owned by his minor son?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, a father inquires about his right to consummate marriage with a slave girl owned by his minor son, to which Imam al-Ridha (AS) replies that he must first emancipate her (*takhliṣ*). This ruling highlights the distinct property rights of minors in Shia jurisprudence and clarifies that the father’s right of *shofah* (option) or direct consummation is contingent upon the girl's free status, ensuring the transaction of ownership is clear before marital relations occur. The emphasis on *takhliṣ* underscores the spiritual and legal value of freeing slaves as a prerequisite for full marital integration in this specific context.
